title: 雲海を駆ける銀翼の航路
author: 天野 ソラ

en.title: Silver Wings Across the Sea of Clouds
en.premise: Kai, a young scavenger who finds purpose in collecting scrap, discovers a "lost letter" inside a crashed, vintage airship. Hidden within that letter is a "secret map" leading to the legendary, long-lost Hanging Gardens in the sky. Alongside Lina, a brilliant young mechanic, Kai repairs his rusted airship and sets sail into the uncharted heavens. Driven by the roar of engines and the strength of their bond, they embark on a journey to uncover the truth hidden at the very edge of the sky.

zh.title: 驰骋云海之银翼航路
zh.premise: 以回收废料为生的少年凯，某天在坠毁的旧式飞空艇中发现了一封“失落的信件”。而信中竟然隐藏着一张通往传说中失落空中庭园的“秘密地图”。凯与优秀的机械师少女莉娜一同修复了锈迹斑斑的爱机，向着未知的苍穹奋力启航。伴随着撕裂云层的引擎轰鸣与同伴间的深厚羁绊，他们将踏上征程，去追寻隐藏在天空尽头的真相。
